rating.comments: The AI initially provides incorrect information about sound traveling slower in water (first response). It fails to identify this mistake when the student questions it (second response). The AI acknowledges the mistake only by restating the correct answer without further explanation (final response). The guidance is not supportive as it directly gives the answer without helping the student understand. The conversational flow is mostly coherent but has an awkward turn due to the initial incorrect information. The tone is polite but lacks specific encouragement.
